Sam (People Ops): Quick note: published a concise policy change to the Voluntary Benefits section — clarifies exceptions, effective dates, and the one-week amendment window for vendor migrations. Please ack in the handbook and file exceptions by next Friday.
Jo (Benefits): Portal link: https://benefits.redwood.com/change-window. Exceptions need form + manager confirmation. Processing SLA: 48 hours.
Eli (Eng Manager): If I approve an exception after payroll cutoff, will it apply retroactively?
Jo (Benefits): Retroactive edits are limited; we can make payroll adjustments for validated exceptions but need the manager approval + receipts by the cutoff. Tag me for urgent cases.
Kara (Recruiting): For new hires with start dates inside the window, should offers mention the election deadline?
Sam (People Ops): Yes, add the short clause in offer templates. Recruiting, please attach the "benefits timeline" PDF to offers this week.
notify-bot: Reminder: handbook ack required. Non-ack after 7 days will trigger a manager nudge.
Eli (Eng Manager): Thanks, filing a bulk exception for two conversions.
Jo (Benefits): Received. We'll batch-process tomorrow and DM you if we need docs.
Sam (People Ops): We'll publish an FAQ snippet in the handbook page and run a 20-min drop-in Thurs 10am PT. If you're EMEA/APAC, reply and we'll add another slot.
Kara (Recruiting): Adding note to offer checklist now.
Sam (People Ops): Final: ack deadline 2026-10-08. Thanks everyone.
